steps.body: Thanks for binding with David Hughes Insurance, {owner_name}. Your policy docs are in your email and my direct line is saved in this thread. - David Hughes, David Hughes Insurance

steps.subject: The gap most owner-operators don't know they have
steps.body: {owner_name} - workers comp doesn't cover you as the owner. Occupational accident does: injury, disability, death benefit while you're under a load. Runs about {occ_acc_price}/mo for most single-truck operations. Reply YES and I'll add it to your file, or grab 10 minutes here: {booking_link}

steps.subject: First 90 days with new authority - the insurance checklist
steps.body: Three things new carriers get wrong: 1) Letting the insurance lapse for even a day - FMCSA can pull your authority. 2) Adding a truck without telling the carrier - that claim can be denied. 3) Not updating your radius when you start running farther. Reply to this email any time you add equipment - it takes me two minutes and it keeps your policy valid.

steps.body_conditional: ONLY if owner_age >= 60. Otherwise swap to: umbrella_liability pitch for the business.
steps.body: {owner_name} - you're {age}, so this is worth sixty seconds of your time: a health bridge plan covers the window until Medicare kicks in at 65. No underwriting, guaranteed issue options. Most owner-operators your age don't know this exists. Want the one-page summary?

steps.subject: Your renewal date is already on my calendar
steps.body: {owner_name} - your commercial auto renews {renewal_date}. I'll be shopping it against at least 3 carriers 45 days out so you never overpay at renewal. If you've added trucks, drivers, or started running a bigger radius, reply now - mid-term updates almost always save money at renewal.

VAPI outbound: 'Hi {owner_name}, David's office - this is the annual audit call we promised. Any changes to trucks, drivers, or cargo? ... While I have you - did you ever look at that occupational accident coverage?' If no contact after 2 attempts, loop sequence back to day 28 and repeat quarterly.
